about: Just Dance 2021 is the ultimate dance game, with 40 hot new tracks from chart-topping hits from artists like Dua Lipa, Twice, Shawn Mendes and Billie Eilish. Start dancing right away in quickplay mode or join the improved dance floor where you can challenge other dancers from all over the world. Time to start a dance party your friends and family can enjoy!
